name: Select Passkey
summary: From Select MFA Type, the user chooses Passkey and the client opens the existing Passkey Start surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.select.mfa-type is visible with Passkey available

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the canonical Passkey Start surface is visible

sourceReferences.note: Starting surface owns the select-passkey action.
Existing canonical Passkey Start surface owns the remaining passkey ceremony.
Angular action:select-passkey navigates to the canonical passkey continuation route.
Select MFA Type has exactly one Passkey-choice scenario ending at Passkey Start.
